issues.description: Method name mismatch for the Stock clearing method: the problem statement's UML and the reference solution declare a method named emptyStock(), but the template repository's Stock class provides a method named clearInventory(). This naming difference (emptyStock vs. clearInventory) is present in the starter code and the assignment text/solution and can confuse students implementing or calling the API (e.g., when following the UML, writing SealSaloon code, or when tests expect emptyStock()).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template API consistent with the problem statement and the reference solution. Either (a) rename the template's clearInventory() method to emptyStock(), preserving its behavior, or (b) add a public void emptyStock() method to the template that delegates to clearInventory(). Update any internal references accordingly so the starter code, UML, and solution all use the same method name.
